reading: Closed UP on invasion day; above pre-war level by 29 Mar (4631.6). June low was the Fed/inflation, not the war.
Peaked at only 36 -- elevated but far below panic (COVID 82, GFC 80). War barely registered as systemic risk.
The transmission channel: +34% at peak. The market priced ENERGY, not a general war.
Yields ROSE -- no sustained safe-haven bid; the Fed/inflation story dominated Treasuries.
Modest safe-haven bid to the dollar; the one durable flight-to-quality signal.
